correctness.rationale: I independently enumerated undirected edge-subset forests, then chose one root in every component and oriented towards it. Face counts 24,234,1192,3357,4968,3024 and F2 boundary ranks 23,211,981,2376,2592 agree. The rational ranks are at least these ranks; the first rank is at most 23 by augmentation, and adjacent ranks saturate the intervening chain dimensions, so the ranks over Q are equal and reduced homology is solely degree five, dimension 432. For an independent trace check, an invariant forest chooses parents on vertex cycles: a length-d tail cycle can choose an opposite-shore length-e parent cycle if e divides d, with e offsets. The orbit-parent digraph is acyclic exactly when its lift is acyclic. Each chosen tail cycle contributes -1 to the alternating signed-face weight, so in odd top degree the character is the sum of products of -e including the empty choice. This gives (432,-16,4,0,-2), (0,0,4,0,-2), (-3,-1,1,-3,1). Specht inner products by permutation, signed-standard and two-subset characters give (2,8,7,9,4), (5,17,12,19,8), (2,8,6,10,3), including two invariants.
